desc.p: Returns the cache lists the user owns, sorted by name.
A list is referenced by its numeric id (lists have no code like caches); the other services/lists methods take it as list_id.
last_modified changes whenever the list or its caches change, also on the website. A client that keeps the lists offline needs to fetch the caches only of lists whose last_modified changed.

opt.name: include_caches
opt.p: true adds the codes of the caches on each list (field cache_codes), so a client gets all lists and their caches in one request.

returns.p: A list of dictionaries, one per list:

ul.li: description - its description in HTML (as the website keeps it; may be empty),
status - 0 private, 2 public, 3 public and shown in cache listings (see list_status in services/lists/create),
password - the password of a private list (empty if none, and for public lists),
is_watched - whether the user watches the list,
date_created, last_modified, last_added - date and time in the installation's time zone ("YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS"); last_added is null while no cache was added,
caches_count - the number of caches on the list,
watches_count - how many users watch the list,
cache_codes - only with include_caches: the codes of the caches on the list.
